auditNotes: Retain initial tagfilter-enabled cmark mixed audit: 39 differences. Correct raw-HTML configuration removes tagfilter and leaves 15, with no regressions.
Nine native tasklist references omit checkboxes under blockquotes; reader retains its existing task behavior with explicit checkbox/tab regressions.
Six existing nested HTML lazy-continuation boundaries remain unsupported; no complete CommonMark claim.

Initial host rendering-tree text matched 240/320 and raw browser Range matched 60/80. Actual runtime DOM matched 320/320; browser Selection and geometry matched 80/80. Inline CSS whitespace collapsing is tracked separately.

Portable browser harness initially selected 120 views against an 80-view count assertion. Selection is now explicit for list, quote-list and list-quote; preserve failed harness report in local ignored outputs.

Final boundary audit reproduced a prototype recursion overflow for a literal tab before > at physical column 2. dequoteLine now consumes up to three visual columns, preserving partial tab stops. 192 new cases: 174 exact, 18 existing raw HTML boundary differences, no regressions.

Initial full gate rejected profile status pass-scoped; schema requires pass/pending/blocked. Follow-up rejected an empty pending queue. Metadata now uses pass with explicit scoped dimensions and records known HTML boundaries as pending.

Final strict browser geometry is 127/128: one native pre versus reader pre-wrap control differs by 1/64px. Changing only native whitespace reproduces both layouts; source text and all 128 selections agree. Separate same-whitespace geometry is 128/128. No pixel tolerance was widened and the original measurements remain present.
